integrity: Standalone analytical proof and a self-contained deterministic numerical checker; numerical tests are non-proofs.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean one-dimensional lengths for fixed R>r>0; limits are not uniform as r/R tends to 0 or 1. Specialist Kroll sources unavailable for full inspection. No experimental noise or noncircular/oblique cylinder theory.
title: Two-sided square-root length cusps and inverse geometry at the generalized Viviani node
